subject.title: fix: prevent operational notices from leaking to source chats

question: Should redirect transcript failure suppress the source-chat notice, and should the new core configuration and Plugin SDK contract become supported product behavior?
rationale: This choice deliberately trades operational visibility and availability for privacy and creates upgrade-sensitive public and persisted behavior; repository history and public discussion do not establish owner intent.

options.title: Accept fail-closed policy
options.body: Keep source suppression after moving once-state to SQLite and explicitly accept the redirect, configuration, persistence, and Plugin SDK contracts.

options.title: Require fallback delivery
options.body: Deliver the notice to the source chat when redirect persistence fails, prioritizing operational visibility over secrecy.

options.title: Narrow the initial feature
options.body: Ship silent suppression without redirect, durable once-state, or Plugin SDK expansion until those contracts are separately approved.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Keep source suppression after moving once-state to SQLite and explicitly accept the redirect, configuration, persistence, and Plugin SDK contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main provenance ties this person to the runtime-notice classification and the shared dispatch, session, heartbeat, and hook boundaries involved in the choice.
